Appraiser remarks
Inspection of the front end shows damage consistent with the reported head-on impact, including the bumper cover, grille, hood
leading edge, and both headlamp assemblies. The pattern of crush and displacement lines up with the stated collision, and the
body shop's labor hours are reasonable for the repairs listed. Billing records were reviewed and show no duplicated line items. A
few minor scratches on the lower door panels appear older than this loss and are noted separately so they are not included in the
repair scope. Recommended plan: replace the bumper cover and headlamps, repair the hood and grille support, refinish affected
panels, and recalibrate the forward radar sensor before release.
